findings.message: `saveOrder(order)` is not awaited, so the handler returns 201 before the order is persisted. A failed save becomes an unhandled rejection while the client is told the order exists.
The request body is cast straight to `Cart` without any validation. Malformed or tampered input, such as client-chosen item prices or quantities, flows unchecked into `orderFromCart` and is saved.
The express order is created without being tied to the signed-in user, and the handler never checks authentication. Later ownership checks on this order therefore cannot work.
